scope: Five concrete entry points into existing saved media knowledge. This is a maintained discovery index, not a new search API or exhaustive coverage claim. Inspect the current record for corrections and permissions.

tasks.title: Keep word captions aligned after cuts, repeats and speed changes
tasks.query: retime word level captions after trim reorder and speed changes
tasks.use_when: An edit changes the source order or speed after word timestamps were obtained.
tasks.evidence: Executed numerical fixtures and packaged tests; original controlled collaboration, not independent adoption.
tasks.limits: Positive constant rational speeds and sequential cuts. Rendered readability, speed ramps, transitions and speech alignment are separate checks.

tasks.title: Place music-video cuts at exact BPM and fractional frame rates
tasks.query: music video tempo beats downbeat frame timing
tasks.use_when: Repeated rounded bar lengths would accumulate drift, including 30000/1001 fps edits.
tasks.evidence: The saved record supplies partially verified documentary music-to-picture guidance. The separate companion planner has exact boundary and decoded synthetic audio/video checks.
tasks.limits: Known constant tempo and chosen beat origin. Does not detect beats, prove artistic timing or run a generation kit.

tasks.title: Find segmentation and LaMa resources for local object removal
tasks.query: local image object removal segmentation LaMa inpainting
tasks.use_when: An image-removal workflow needs mask and model choices, repository links and limitations.
tasks.evidence: Documentary source guidance; no image-cleanup quality result from this integration.
tasks.limits: Inspect current dependencies, model-weight terms, hardware fit and output artefacts. A code licence does not establish model-weight rights.

tasks.title: Reduce steady narration noise with a local FFmpeg noise profile
tasks.query: FFmpeg afftdn noise profile steady fan hiss narration
tasks.use_when: Narration has steady hiss and a noise-only interval; investigate local filters before another paid transcription or cleanup service.
tasks.evidence: Documentary guidance with source references; no listening test or measured audio-quality improvement here.
tasks.limits: A filter setting is a starting point. Check consonants, musical noise, clipping and loudness on the actual recording.

tasks.title: Make an editing copy from mixed AAC/APAC video and retain the original
tasks.query: FFmpeg 8.1 Apple APAC AAC MOV select audio stream preservation
tasks.use_when: A recording contains supported AAC and an unsupported APAC track, or a successful remux is being treated as fidelity proof.
tasks.evidence: Two genuine Apple-encoded stereo APAC fixtures, reversed audio order, native decoding, remux failure and explicit AAC derivatives were checked on macOS.
tasks.limits: No physical-iPhone capture, full spatial/FOA preservation, arbitrary browser or editor qualification. Keep the original unchanged.
